title: Motion for an extension of time to file the briefs on the merits

pages.text:
Andrew T. Tutt
+1 202.942.5245 Direct
andrew.tutt@arnoldporter.com

Arnold & Porter Kaye Scholer LLP
601 Massachusetts Ave, NW  |  Washington, DC 20001-3743  |  www.arnoldporter.com


March 25, 2025
VIA ELECTRONIC MAIL
The Honorable Scott S. Harris
Clerk of the Court
Supreme Court of the United States
One First Street, NE
Washington, D.C. 20543
Re: Berk v. Choy, No. 24-440
Dear Mr. Harris:
I represent petitioner in the above-captioned case, in which the petition for a writ
of certiorari was granted on March 10, 2025. Petitioner’s opening brief is currently due on
April 24, and respondents’ opening brief is due on May 27.
Because of schedulin g difficulties and the press of other cases, petitioner
respectfully requests, under Rule 30.4 of the Rules of this Court, that the time within which
to file petitioner’s opening brief (and the joint appendix) be extended to and including May
27, and the time within which to file respondents’ briefs be extended to and including July
30. If those extensions are granted, petitioner’s reply brief would be due on August 29.
Respondents’ counsel has authorized me to represent that respondents consent to
the proposed briefing schedule.
Sincerely,

Andrew T. Tutt
cc:   Frederick Yarger, Counsel for Respondent Dr. Wilson C. Choy
Sarah Harrington, Counsel for Respondent Beebe Medical Center
